subject: Update the multiple selections of a select id via Jquery

messages.author: 92d4b0993c9bf75e
messages.subject: Update the multiple selections of a select id via Jquery
parts:
Hello,

One section of my ui.R is this

,fluidRow(column(12, htmlOutput("headsup")))

This is populated in server.R as

    output[[ "headsup" ]] <-  renderText({
        t1 <- refData()$t1
        a <- refData()$a
        finalString <- paste(unlist(Map(function(a,b){
            sprintf("%s%s",a,b)
        },a$indent, a$tailString)),collapse="\n")
        sprintf("<pre id='hedup'>%s</pre>",finalString)
    })

The finalString is a lot of <a href='#' onClick='yourFunction(this); return false;' ..

and yourFunction is (#sbpr is the id of a 'select ')


function yourFunction(d){
    let o = JSON.parse(d.getAttribute("data-sel"));
    if (o['bpr']){
        console.log(['bpr',o['bpr']])
        console.log(document.getElementById('sbpr'));
        document.getElementById('sbpr').value = o['bpr'];
        $("#sbpr").val(o['bpr']);
        $('#sbpr').trigger('change', true);
        console.log($("#sbpr"));
    }

now, though a change is triggered, the select box doesn't update itself to show the new selections.
How can i force that?

Cheers
Sapsi
